args.title: Change localhost to public URL in password reset email
args.body: Issue 4201 reports that the password reset email contains a link that incorrectly points to localhost. The link is constructed in the src/notifications/templates.ts file using a BASE_URL constant that defaults to 'http://localhost:3000' if no public URL is provided. To fix this, we will modify the BASE_URL to ensure it points to the correct public URL instead of localhost, enhancing the user experience by ensuring that users can access the password reset link correctly.
